scope: Overlay selection, load/init/unload paths and shared object-factory layout. Static evidence and exact C matches; specific gameplay roles remain unknown.

functions.name: LoadOverlay053
functions.behavior: Loads overlay 53 and runs its initializer as the default branch of this loading system.
functions.evidence: The wrapper supplies overlay ID 53 to arm9:02029f78 and calls the entry at 020d21e0; its loaded module is therefore ov053, resolving the ambiguous static address.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known.

functions.name: LoadOverlay059
functions.behavior: Loads overlay 59 and runs its initializer for loading mode 1.
functions.evidence: The wrapper supplies overlay ID 59 to arm9:02029f78 and calls the entry at 020c7460; its loaded module is ov059.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known.

functions.name: LoadOverlay060
functions.behavior: Loads overlay 60 and registers its object factory for loading mode -1.
functions.evidence: The wrapper supplies overlay ID 60 then calls ov060:020c7460, which passes its allocation factory to ov001:0206dd84.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known.

functions.name: LoadNextOverlayForSelection
functions.behavior: Chooses the last available slot for the current selection, loads its overlay, and runs its initializer.
functions.evidence: Three tracked slots are checked from index 2 down to 0 against a selection-specific ID table and initializer table. The selected ID is recorded before the load.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known. Callers must provide an eligible slot; the original function has no valid fallback when all slots fail.

functions.name: LoadOverlayForMode
functions.prototype: int LoadOverlayForMode(unsigned int selectionIndex, int mode);
functions.behavior: Selects one of four overlay-loading paths from the requested mode.
functions.evidence: Modes -1, 1 and 2 call the ov060, ov059 and selection-dependent paths; zero and other modes load ov053. The selection index is forwarded.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known.

functions.name: UnloadTrackedOverlay
functions.behavior: Unloads an overlay and frees its first matching tracked slot so it can be used again.
functions.evidence: The function calls arm9:02029f98 then scans the three IDs at ov051:020c7440, replacing the first matching entry with -1.
functions.uncertainty: The loading operation is established, but the selection and mode meanings and the created object's specific in-game role are not yet known.

functions.name: LoadOverlay
functions.behavior: Loads executable overlay code before its initializer can run.
functions.evidence: Ghidra shows an ITCM synchronization helper followed by arm9:0200bd64. That function loads overlay info, loads its image and starts it; ov051 passes the numeric overlay IDs and calls entry points in those modules. Shared Days wrapper src/calls/func_0201e470.c identifies the corresponding operation as FS_LoadOverlay.
functions.uncertainty: The exact purpose of the preceding ITCM synchronization helper is not established here.

functions.name: UnloadOverlay
functions.behavior: Unloads executable overlay code when its tracked slot is released.
functions.evidence: Paired with LoadOverlay by ov051:020c73a4; the underlying arm9:0200bdb8 loads overlay info then invokes its unload helper before the caller clears the tracked ID.
functions.uncertainty: Overlay lifetime is controlled by callers; this wrapper does not itself clear ov051 tracking slots.

functions.name: RegisterOverlay060Factory
functions.behavior: Installs the creation callback used to allocate the object implemented by overlay 60.
functions.evidence: The 20-byte function passes ov060:020c7474 to ov001:0206dd84. The latter stores the factory pointer at ov001:020a04a0. The ov051 mode -1 path loads overlay60 before invoking this entry.
functions.uncertainty: The object's specific game role has not been established; no enemy or battle-system identity is assigned.

functions.name: CreateOverlay060Object
functions.behavior: Allocates and initializes the object used by overlay 60 with variant 1 and selection index 0.
functions.evidence: Allocates 0x230 bytes through arm9:0202a178, calls ov021:020a75a4 with (object,1,0), and returns the same allocation. That initializer clears 0x230 bytes and stores the variant, option, shared selection, and update callback.
functions.uncertainty: Variant 1 and selection index 0 are observed values; their in-game meanings remain unproven.

functions.name: SetOverlayObjectFactory
functions.behavior: Remembers the currently selected overlay-object creation callback.
functions.evidence: The complete function stores its first argument at ov001:020a04a0. ov060 supplies CreateOverlay060Object.
functions.uncertainty: The later factory consumer and object's specific game role still need investigation.

functions.name: InitializeOverlayObject
functions.prototype: void InitializeOverlayObject(OverlayObject *object, int variant, int selectionIndex);
functions.behavior: Clears and initializes a shared object with its variant, selection index, selection record and update callback.
functions.evidence: Disassembly and Ghidra show a 0x230-byte clear, stores at +0, +0x1d4, +0x1d8 and +0x1f4. Callers include ov052, ov059 and ov060. The callback address is ov021:020a7a40, stored with its Thumb bit. The selection-record getter takes the index and returns data_02060b50 + index * 0x144.
functions.uncertainty: The object class, selection byte meanings and callback's game effect are unresolved; fields beyond the observed writes remain reserved.

functions.name: GetOverlaySelectionRecord
functions.behavior: Returns the shared selection record whose first byte selects an overlay set.
functions.evidence: The complete 16-byte Thumb function returns 0x02060b50 + selectionIndex * 0x144. ov051:020c72f0 reads its first byte and uses it as the row index in parallel overlay-ID and initializer tables. ov021 initialization stores the returned record pointer.
functions.uncertainty: The specific meaning and allowed range of the selection index and the rest of each record remain unknown.

globals.name: availableOverlayIds
globals.evidence: Three rows of three signed overlay IDs select ov054, ov055 or ov057; -1 marks absent entries. The load function uses a 12-byte row stride.

globals.name: overlayInitializers
globals.evidence: A parallel three-by-three callback table is checked before a slot is selected and invoked after loading its module.

globals.name: loadedOverlayIds
globals.evidence: Three signed IDs initialized to -1. Loading records a chosen overlay, and unloading resets its first matching slot to -1.

globals.name: currentOverlayObjectFactory
globals.evidence: SetOverlayObjectFactory stores its callback argument here; ov060 supplies its 0x230-byte allocation function.
